known_issues.detail: Items whose answer is a dataset identifier such as "data_3773" carry scorer="numeric". The numeric scorer extracts the digit run, so these still discriminate correctly against other datasets; they are NOT re-typed here, but a stricter exact-match reading is defensible and would change their difficulty.
Items were produced by a deterministic query over a fact index and then reviewed; the release carries no per-item review record, no independent multi-rater annotation, and no agreement statistic.
